name: cover
prompt: Create a fresh square editorial cover for a friendly Korean technology explainer. Photorealistic overhead scene of a bright real parcel sorting installation with clean white surfaces, three cobalt blue diverging tracks and a single small kraft parcel at the junction, convincing material texture, warm daylight. Toss-inspired restrained blue/white palette, sophisticated generous negative space. Extremely large legible Korean typography occupying upper half: ‘AI가 고르는 법’, second smaller bold line ‘긴 답보다 작은 선택’. Tiny bottom label ‘Decisions API’. Typography should dominate at phone size. No logos, fake software screenshot, small unreadable text, cartoon or stock laptop desk. This is a conceptual editorial photo, not documentation of an actual OpenAI facility.

name: section1
prompt: Fresh horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial image. Wide eye-level perspective inside a small bright mailroom: a real belt with several plain envelopes and parcels dividing toward four distinct blue metal collection bins, a worker seen only from shoulders down thoughtfully guiding one envelope. Natural tactile materials, realistic soft daylight, calm white and cobalt accents. Convey choosing the destination instead of writing a long explanation. No readable words, brand logos, UI overlays, charts, corporate claims, robot, laptop desk. Distinct composition from overhead cover.

name: section2
prompt: Fresh horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial image of three tactile ways of judging an ordinary object in a sunny workshop. Foreground a magnifying glass checking a chipped ceramic tile, midground several unordered differently shaped sample trays, background a stepped wooden display with samples progressing in visible wear. Compose as one coherent still life in a real spacious craft studio, cream light and restrained cobalt details, crisp material textures, shallow but sufficient depth of field. No labels, numbers, chart, screen, brand, people or graphic card. A conceptual illustration of condition checking, choosing a category and ordered grading, not a scientific measurement.

name: section3
prompt: Fresh horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial photo at oblique close angle in a sunlit archive digitization corner. One sheet of nonsensitive unmarked diagram paper feeding a slim portable USB single-sided document scanner, USB cable visibly attached to a generic computer whose screen is out of focus. Stacks of unlabelled folders and one unobtrusive cobalt tray provide context. Real device scale and paper texture. No Epson or OpenAI logo, readable personal information, automated API integration claims, glowing fantasy effects, sales banner, office portrait or recycled desk composition. Show preparing a paper document as an image, not the AI judging it.

name: section4
prompt: Fresh horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial photo of a human quality reviewer in a ceramic repair workshop comparing two printed sample photos with the same real cracked cup on a daylight inspection table. Only hands and torso visible, one hand carefully points at the crack, the other holds a neutral pencil. A separate blue tray holds uncertain samples for later manual review. Natural warm workshop context, believable lived-in tools, tasteful cobalt accents. No readable text, screen, identity data, authoritative stamp, approval guarantee, institutional branding or laptop. Illustrate human review after uncertain classification.

name: section5
prompt: Fresh horizontal 3:2 photorealistic editorial photo in a makerspace at morning light. A compact test rig on a waist-high white workbench: a small batch of five plain sample cards beside a simple physical routing gate with cobalt and grey destinations. An adult hand adjusts a labelled-free mechanical stop before the next card is fed, suggesting a small bounded trial and a person deciding the next step. Wider context includes clean shelving and soft tools. No text, prices, financial graphics, brand logo, fake API UI, robot or computer desk. Calm approachable high-end magazine photography, restrained blue and white color palette.
